data.one_liner: Generate inline links that can be selected and tapped in text for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display text with automatically detected links that users can both tap and select. Supports custom regular expression patterns, custom link styling, shrinking URLs, and handling tap or long-press events.
use_when: You need selectable text that contains clickable URLs, email addresses, or phone numbers.
You want to customize link patterns (e.g., matching hashtags or custom markdown-like link syntax).
avoid_when: You only need standard non-selectable text links.
You do not need URL autolinking capabilities.
strengths: Supports text selection alongside clickable inline links.
Customizable link patterns and regex capabilities.
Supports touch interactions like onTap and onLongPress for links.
weaknesses: Not documented for complex rich text formatting beyond standard link attributes and custom regex matchers.
Limited to text and link handling use cases.
